shapeSummary: Simplified Yellow Jacket gear motor: a 37 mm diameter by 105 mm long cylindrical body with its axis along Z, centered at X=0 and Z=0, with the bottom at Y=0. An 8 mm diameter, 80 mm long output shaft extends from the +Z gearbox face.
warnings: Body diameter (37 mm) and body length (105 mm) are estimates, not dimensioned in the source.
The 80 mm length is taken as the shaft length, so the overall part extends past the 105 mm body envelope in +Z and is not centered on Z overall.
The shaft is modeled as a plain 8 mm cylinder; the REX profile and the tapped M4 end hole are omitted.
The gearbox screw holes, encoder housing, motor can steps, wires, connectors and the yellow jacket are omitted because they are uncertain or decorative.
